cases.testName: agent completion claim cannot prove an unverified goal
cases.expected: Completion is refused and the goal remains active without trusted evidence.

cases.testName: one passing check cannot bypass another semantic acceptance requirement
cases.expected: A passing mechanical check cannot complete a goal with an unproven semantic requirement.

cases.testName: goal constraints are mandatory semantic completion requirements
cases.expected: Passing mechanical checks cannot complete a Goal while a declared contract constraint remains unproven.

cases.testName: goal contract exposes success criteria and enforced constraints without pausing work
cases.expected: The contract view exposes outcome, success criteria, constraints and host checks while remaining read-only and command-owned.

cases.testName: goal created from Plan is persisted paused instead of executing
cases.expected: Plan can define the Goal Contract but the resulting Goal is persisted paused and receives planning-only guidance rather than an implementation continuation.

cases.testName: Plan cannot resume a Goal but Build can explicitly resume and repin execution
cases.expected: Plan cannot activate execution; after the user switches to Build, an explicit resume activates the same Goal and pins future continuation to Build.

cases.testName: idle cannot auto-continue an active Goal bound to Plan
cases.expected: A legacy or raced active Goal bound to Plan is paused on idle and no continuation prompt is dispatched.

cases.testName: startup recovery pauses an active persisted Plan Goal before any prompt
cases.expected: Process restart cannot recover a persisted Plan-bound Goal into autonomous execution; it is paused before any host prompt.

cases.testName: progress notes do not count as host-observed progress
cases.expected: Three narration-only continuation turns pause the goal with stalledTurns=3.

cases.testName: blocker requires three distinct turns
cases.expected: Repeating a blocker inside one turn does not inflate the counter; the third distinct turn blocks.

cases.testName: active goal owns compaction context and generic auto-continue
cases.expected: Persistent goal state is injected into compaction and generic post-compaction auto-continue is disabled.

cases.testName: restart recovery preserves interrupted-turn accounting and prompt ownership
cases.expected: Recovery waits for bootstrap, restores command ownership, and does not count the interrupted turn as stalled.

cases.testName: cleared unfinished goal restores paused and only resumes after explicit command
cases.expected: Restore preserves the archived Goal but returns it paused; work resumes only after an explicit /goal resume command.

cases.testName: restore cannot overwrite a different unfinished live goal
cases.expected: Restore fails closed while another unfinished Goal is live and does not change that live Goal.

cases.testName: unsupported live Goal schema fails closed without overwriting stored bytes
cases.expected: Unknown live-state schema is never treated as an empty slot; load/list/save/clear refuse it and preserve exact stored bytes.

cases.testName: corrupt archive blocks history restore and prune without deleting evidence
cases.expected: Malformed archive JSON blocks history mutation and restore rather than being skipped, rewritten, or deleted.

cases.testName: goal doctor stays available for unsupported live storage and never rewrites it
cases.expected: The plugin still loads, doctor identifies the unsupported live state, and exact stored bytes remain unchanged.

cases.testName: startup recovery scan isolates corrupt shards and keeps healthy active goals
cases.expected: A corrupt shard is skipped without mutation while healthy active Goals remain eligible for restart recovery.

cases.testName: live Goal storage refuses symlink or junction escape before any external write
cases.expected: A symlink or junction in the live Goal storage path is classified unsafe before read/write/startup traversal and no external files are created.

cases.testName: archive history refuses symlink or junction escape before read or prune
cases.expected: A symlink or junction in archive storage blocks history read/prune and leaves the external target untouched.

cases.testName: live cross-process lease blocks a second writer until timeout
cases.expected: A live process lease cannot be stolen; the contender times out without mutating the Goal and can write only after release.

cases.testName: two stale process snapshots cannot both commit
cases.expected: Two independent processes racing from the same generation yield exactly one commit and one stale_write conflict.

cases.testName: dead process lease is reclaimed without stealing a live owner
cases.expected: A lease is reclaimed only after its owner process is dead; recovery persists normally and leaves no canonical lock behind.

cases.testName: explicit OpenCode usage limit stops automatic goal retry while generic retry remains active
cases.expected: Explicit account quota becomes usage_limited and aborts retry; generic transient retry stays active.

cases.testName: budget-limited goal cannot resume until its budget is raised
cases.expected: An exhausted local budget cannot be bypassed by resume; raising the limit preserves usage and revision.

cases.testName: goal edit aborts the old turn, suppresses abort-idle, and rejects stale revision activity
cases.expected: User edit wins the race; stale revision patches/progress cannot mutate the revised goal.
